title: Namo Bharat Luggage Rules: Permissible Weight, Size Limit, and Security Checks
description: Planning a smooth journey on the Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS) requires knowing the exact luggage limits and security policies before reaching the station platform.
body:
Planning a smooth journey on the Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS) requires knowing the exact luggage limits and security policies before reaching the station platform. Under the official guidelines managed by the National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC), passengers are permitted to carry personal baggage up to **25 kg free of charge**, provided the dimensions do not exceed **80 cm x 50 cm x 30 cm**. Strict security screening enforced by the Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) and security personnel ensures that prohibited items like flammable liquids, sharp objects, and unsealed hazardous goods are confiscated at the entry gates.

While the basic weight and size limits get you through the turnstiles, navigating multi-modal interchanges, utilizing overhead racks, managing oversized luggage, and understanding specific security exceptions require a closer look at the operational rules.

For a complete overview of the corridor including station lists, ticket pricing, and train schedules, read our [Namo Bharat RRTS Guide 2026: Routes, Stations, Timings & Fare Guide](https://metroguideindia.com/blog/namo-bharat-rrts-guide-2026-routes-stations-timings-fare-complete-travel-guide.html).

## Key Namo Bharat Luggage Rules at a Glance

The following table summarizes the primary regulations enforced across all operational RRTS stations between Delhi, Ghaziabad, and Meerut:

| **Luggage Parameter** | **Official NCRTC Standard** | **Notes & Exceptions** |
| **Maximum Free Weight** | 25 kg per ticketed passenger | Children with valid tickets get full allowance. |
| **Maximum Dimensions** | 80 cm (L) x 50 cm (W) x 30 cm (H) | Must fit through X-ray scanner units. |
| **Overhead Rack Capacity** | Designed for standard cabin bags & backpacks | Heavy items must be kept at floor level near seats. |
| **Security Handling** | X-ray screening + manual frisking | Mandatory for all hand-carried items. |
| **Baggage Allowance Fee** | No excess baggage booking option currently | Oversized items are denied entry at gates. |

## Detailed Luggage Weight Limits and Size Restrictions

Understanding the **Namo Bharat Luggage Rules** helps prevent delays during X-ray scanning or baggage rejection at entry gates. Unlike long-distance Indian Railways trains that allow up to 40 kg or 70 kg depending on the travel class, urban rapid rail networks prioritize passenger clearance speeds and cabin safety.

### Weight Limit Breakdown

- **Standard Allowance:** Every commuter holding a valid QR ticket, NCMC card, or digital pass can carry up to **25 kg** of personal baggage.
- **Co-Travelers and Families:** Weight limits apply per individual ticket holder. A family of four holding separate tickets can carry four individual pieces within the permitted weight and size thresholds.
- **No Commercial Freight:** Personal baggage rules apply strictly to personal belongings. Carrying merchandise, wholesale goods, or commercial trade packages inside passenger coaches is prohibited under the **Namo Bharat Luggage Rules**.

### Dimension and Size Limits

The maximum overall dimensions allowed for any single piece of luggage are **80 cm in length, 50 cm in width, and 30 cm in height**.

```plain
+-------------------------------------------------------+
|                 MAXIMUM BAGGAGE SIZE                  |
|                                                       |
|   Length:  80 cm (31.5 inches)                        |
|   Width:   50 cm (19.6 inches)                        |
|   Height:  30 cm (11.8 inches)                        |
|                                                       |
|   * Must easily pass through standard security X-rays  |
+-------------------------------------------------------+

```

These dimension limits serve two operational functions:

1. **X-Ray Scanner Fit:** Larger trunks or boxes cannot physically pass through the automated baggage scanners stationed at concourse entries.
2. **Coach Clearance:** The gangways and seating layouts in both Standard and Premium coaches are designed to allow fast boarding. Oversized luggage blocks aisles and creates safety hazards during rapid stops.

## Security Screening and Prohibited Items Checklist

Security across the Namo Bharat corridor is managed under strict protocols to safeguard high-speed regional travel. All personal items undergo X-ray inspection before passengers proceed to the platform level.

### Strictly Prohibited Items

Security personnel will confiscate the following items instantly at the checkpoint:

- **Flammable Liquids & Gases:** Petrol, kerosene, lighter fluid, paint thinners, compressed gas cylinders, and alcohol containers exceeding permissible personal volume thresholds.
- **Sharp Objects & Tools:** Knives with blades over 6 cm, meat cleavers, scissors, multi-tools, razors, saws, drills, and heavy construction equipment.
- **Explosives & Weapons:** Firearms, ammunition, firecrackers, pyrotechnics, and replica weapons or toys that closely resemble firearms.
- **Corrosive & Toxic Chemicals:** Acids, alkalis, mercury, bleach, insecticides, and radioactive or biohazardous substances.

### Allowed Items with Restrictions

- **Laptops & Power Banks:** Permitted inside personal carry-on bags. Power banks up to 20,000 mAh are allowed without prior declaration.
- **Medical Equipment:** Portable oxygen cylinders, mobility aids, and medical kits are allowed following physical inspection by security officers.
- **Packaged Food & Beverages:** Sealed snacks, water bottles, and non-alcoholic beverages are permitted through security, though consumption inside coaches must adhere to train cleanliness regulations.

## Boarding with Luggage: Standard Class vs. Premium Class

Managing your bags on board varies slightly depending on which coach class you select.

### Standard Class Coaches

Standard coaches feature 2x2 transverse seating with overhead luggage racks running along both sides of the cabin interior.

- Overhead racks accommodate small to medium-sized suitcases, duffel bags, and backpacks.
- Place larger, heavier bags upright near your feet or within designated space gaps between back-to-back seat rows to keep central aisles clear.

### Premium Class Coach

The single Premium Class coach on every Namo Bharat train provides reclining seats, individual charging sockets, and wider overhead luggage compartments.

- Premium passengers enjoy additional storage space per seat, making it easier to secure hand luggage comfortably.
- Keep your ticket or digital QR code readily accessible, as ticket checkers verify Premium Class fares onboard.

If your trip involves transferring from Namo Bharat to the Delhi Metro (DMRC) or Indian Railways, note that luggage policies differ across transit networks:

| **Transit System** | **Max Free Weight** | **Dimension Limits** | **Key Consideration** |
| **Namo Bharat (RRTS)** | 25 kg | 80 x 50 x 30 cm | Checked at RRTS station gates. |
| [**Delhi Metro**](https://metroguideindia.com/delhi-metro/) **(DMRC)** | 25 kg | 80 x 50 x 30 cm | Similar baggage limits; requires security re-screening at interchanges without direct travel zones. |
| **Indian Railways** | 35 kg – 70 kg (Class-based) | Varies by travel class | Larger trunks allowed on long-distance trains, but won't pass RRTS security scanners. |

### Transfer Tips at Major Hubs

- **Anand Vihar Hub:** Connecting between the RRTS station, Delhi Metro Pink/Blue Lines, Anand Vihar ISBT, and Anand Vihar Railway Terminal involves significant walking. Ensure your luggage has functional wheels to navigate foot overbridges and smooth travel corridors efficiently.
- **Sarai Kale Khan Hub:** Direct travel paths connect RRTS platforms with Hazrat Nizamuddin Railway Station and the Pink Line Metro station, minimizing physical luggage lifting across multi-level transfers.

Learn more about overall travel routes and local transit networks on [ Metro Guide India Main Portal](https://metroguideindia.com/).

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

### What happens if my luggage exceeds the weight or size limit?

If your baggage exceeds 25 kg or fails to fit through the X-ray scanner, security staff will deny entry to the station concourse. There are currently no baggage check-in or excess fee facilities on the RRTS network.

### Are trolley bags with wheels allowed on Namo Bharat trains?

Yes, standard wheel-equipped trolley bags, cabin luggage, and rolling duffels are permitted, provided they meet the maximum dimensional limit of 80 cm x 50 cm x 30 cm.

### Can I carry sports equipment or musical instruments on board?

Small sports equipment (such as cricket bats or badminton kits in bags) and compact instruments (like violins or guitars in soft cases) are allowed if they pass through security screening and can be stowed safely without blocking aisles.

### Is luggage storage available at Namo Bharat stations?

Cloakroom facilities and luggage storage lockers are not available at RRTS stations for safety and security reasons. Passengers must keep their belongings with them at all times.

## Final Commuter Checklist

Before leaving for the station, review this quick checklist to ensure a hassle-free journey under the official **Namo Bharat Luggage Rules**:

1. **Weigh Your Bags:** Keep total weight under **25 kg per passenger**.
2. **Measure Dimensions:** Confirm your bag does not exceed **80 cm x 50 cm x 30 cm**.
3. **Pack Prohibited Items Away:** Remove sharp objects, flammable materials, or unsealed liquids before security checks.
4. **Use Trolleys Wisely:** Utilize elevators at station hubs when transferring between RRTS platforms, metro lines, and bus terminals.
